# Brandex — Technical Profile & Knowledge Graph
> Digital Systems & Infrastructure Engineering Company based in Bangalore, India.

Brandex designs, develops, and deploys high-performance web applications, cloud infrastructure, smart classroom LMS portals, and automated business workflows.

## Core Offerings
- **Bespoke Web Platform Engineering**: Sub-second page loads, custom React/TypeScript architectures, edge CDN routing, zero vendor lock-in, and 100% client source code IP.
- **Enterprise Automation & Cloud Architecture**: Event-driven pipelines, automated webhook integrations, PostgreSQL database scaling, and distributed business systems.
- **Brandex Education Platform**: State Syllabus (KSEEB Classes 6 to 10) digital classroom LMS, smartboard video lessons, and real-time formative quizzes.
- **Brandex Builder Community**: 500+ Bangalore software engineers and students collaborating on open-source repositories, developer sprints, and technical bootcamps.

## Key Technical Standards
- Time To First Byte (TTFB): Under 18ms globally
- Client Code Ownership: 100% Client Source Code & Architecture IP
- Hosting & Delivery: Edge-optimized Vercel & Cloudflare CDN
- Technology Stack: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, TailwindCSS, Three.js, WebGL
